description: This file contains setup and data generation functions for educational data in an ERPNext demo module, including creating students, courses, fees, and assessment groups.

methods.name: setup_data
methods.description: Initializes the educational setup by creating masters, items, students, groups, fees, and assessment groups.

methods.name: make_masters
methods.description: Imports master data such as Room, Department, Instructor, Course, Program, etc.

methods.name: setup_item
methods.description: Loads item data from a JSON file and creates Item documents with random minimum order quantities.

methods.name: make_student_applicants
methods.description: Creates student applicant records with randomized personal data and email addresses.

methods.name: make_student_group
methods.description: Generates student groups for each academic term and program.

methods.name: make_fees_category
methods.description: Creates various fee categories with descriptions.

methods.name: make_fees_structure
methods.description: Creates fee structures for each program and academic term with random amounts.

methods.name: make_assessment_groups
methods.description: Creates hierarchical assessment groups for each academic year and term.

methods.name: get_json_path
methods.description: Constructs the file path for JSON data files based on doctype.

methods.name: weighted_choice
methods.description: Selects an index based on weighted probabilities.
